args.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Grave Accord production boss sprite: draw ONE COMPLETE THREE-FRAME HURT/RECOVERY strip in three equal columns, one row, genuine transparent RGBA. Use the supplied seeded canvas as exact identity authority: gaunt dead lamplighter, dark teal peaked cap, dry black ink and broad quiet matte gouache triangular torn teal coat, cream shirt, brown boots and leg wraps. Same south-east 3/4 facing and identical body scale in all three frames, exactly one brass cage lantern in physical LEFT hand, viewer right. Frame 1: very small flinch back, shoulders recoil but both feet remain planted and left hand keeps lantern handle. Frame 2: recoil peaks slightly with coat hem following, intact anatomy and physical-left lantern. Frame 3: settles almost to the original neutral stance. This is a brief non-displacing pain response, not an attack, not a fall, not a turnaround. Keep cap height, boot positions, face structure, same outfit proportions, sleeve continuity and lantern design across frames; consistent original character. Show each complete figure large with generous transparent margins and empty gutters. No glow haze, particles, blood sprays, scenery, ground shadow, labels, text, borders or checkerboard paint. Draw the full strip in one pass; do not mirror or swap hands.

args.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Grave Accord production boss sprite: ONE COMPLETE EIGHT-FRAME DEFEAT animation sheet, exact FOUR columns by TWO rows, read left-to-right then down, genuine transparent RGBA. The seeded lamplighter is the exact original identity: gaunt undead face, dark teal peaked cap, triangular torn teal coat over cream shirt, brown boots and wraps, exactly one brass caged lantern in the physical LEFT hand, viewer right. Same south-east 3/4 facing and same physical body scale across every frame. Draw one continuous clear collapse without vanishing: 1 standing neutral from reference, 2 shoulders slump and knees bend, 3 drops one knee, 4 sinks onto both knees with lantern lowered, 5 leans sideways toward viewer right, 6 supports body briefly with free right forearm as lantern settles beside left hand, 7 lies on the side with knees folded and coat settling, 8 same complete body at rest on its side, cap remains on and one intact lantern on the ground beside left hand. Keep the same head, two arms, two legs and clothing anatomy; no elongation, extra limbs, duplicated or detached head, no disappearing parts. Whole bodies including lying figures must fit their cells with generous transparent margins. Important: do NOT enlarge the crouching/lying frames to fill the cell: the standing frame's skull, hands and boots establish ONE constant physical scale for the entire sheet. Keep the ground contact baseline consistent across frames; no camera motion or zoom. Original dry black ink outlines and broad matte opaque gouache fabric; quiet surfaces and selective face/hand/lantern detail. No sparkles, particles, fog, blood spray, body fragments, scenery, ground/shadow paint, typography, labels, borders or checkerboard. Draw all eight frames together. Return the sheet only.
